about: Text: a name with a space at the end, a station name that starts with an em space (a space), a name that ends with a no-break space (not one), too long a number, a control character in an id.
problems: the name must not start or end with a space or contain a control character
line "l": a station name must not be empty, start or end with a space, or contain a control character
train "123456789012345678901234567890123": the number must be 1 to 32 characters, with no space at either end and no control character
duty "d": the id must be 1 to 32 characters, with no space at either end and no control character
